description: Curated 32-episode shortlist from the Protrusive Dental Podcast, selected against Ali's criteria: clinical judgment in practice, patient communication, stress/mindset, system/business insider knowledge, risk/legal, when-things-go-wrong, team dynamics, what separates great dentists. Ranked via title + full-description keyword scoring then pruned with judgment. Processed in waves of 5.
